raw_response: {"diagnosis":"silver_transactions has an undocumented filter, `ingest_ts - txn_ts <= 26 HOUR`, that silently drops POSTED transactions arriving more than 26 hours after the transaction time. The change notes mention no such rule, and the raw data shows batches routinely carry multi-day-old transactions. This explains the 60-100 missing rows per batch beyond the roughly 4% that are REVERSED. The fix removes the lateness filter and keeps the status filter.","decision":"fix","confidence":0.6,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
